sources.name: Saltire Motorcycles, a dealer of Royal Enfield: Himalayan 411, the specifications
BikeDekho, Royal Enfield Himalayan 411, the specifications: the kerb weight with ABS

numbers.name: width
numbers.standard: The overall width: of the bars with their grips.

numbers.name: height
numbers.standard: The overall height: the top of the mirrors over the ground.

numbers.name: wheelbase
numbers.standard: The wheelbase: from the front axle to the rear axle.

numbers.name: seat height
numbers.standard: The seat height: the lowest point of the top of the seat at the place of the rider.

numbers.name: ground clearance
numbers.standard: The ground clearance: the lowest point between the axles, with no wheel and no chain (the chain turns with the sprocket of the rear wheel).

numbers.name: curb mass
numbers.standard: The kerb weight with ABS. The sources of the Himalayan give 182 to 199 kg. The parts that the drawing does not show (the electrics, the brackets, the inside of the hubs) have masses by estimate, so the tolerance is 10%.
